title: Provider capability boundary
objective: Introduce an AstrBot-inspired provider capability metadata boundary before implementing STT/TTS/Embedding/Rerank providers.

steps.description: Study AstrBot ProviderType, provider adapter metadata registration, abstract provider classes, and manager capability buckets.
Add ProviderCapability and ProviderAdapterMetadata to the Rust provider registry.
Make chat provider registration automatically publish chat_completion metadata while allowing future non-chat metadata registration.
Add tests proving built-in chat providers expose metadata and non-chat metadata cannot be built as chat providers.
Run formatting, workspace tests, clippy, and CLI smoke verification.
